req.title: Location header on create
req.statement: The system shall set Location: /players/{new_id} on the 201 Created response.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-027 requires that POST /players/ returns HTTP 201 and sets a Location header pointing to the newly created resource. Examining the source, the route sets response.headers['Location'] = f'/players/squadnumber/{player.squad_number}' (not /players/{new_id}). Tests must verify: (1) positive — a valid new player yields 201 + correct Location header value; (2) negative — a duplicate squad_number yields 409 and no Location header; (3) boundary — squad_number at the edge of the pre-loaded dataset (27, one above the max of 26) still produces 201 + correct Location. Additional tests cover exact header key casing, body payload fields, and the conflict path to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_post_player_returns_201_and_location_header
preconditions: Database contains 26 pre-loaded players with squad numbers 1-26
Squad number 99 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with a valid payload using squad_number=99
expected: Response body contains the created player with squad_number=99
trace: R-PLAYER-027: Location header set on 201 Created
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=True)

def test_post_player_returns_201_and_location_header():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    assert "location" in {k.lower() for k in r.headers}
    location = r.headers.get("location") or r.headers.get("Location")
    assert location == "/players/squadnumber/99"
    body = r.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"

test_post_player_returns_201_and_location_header()

tests.name: test_post_player_location_header_reflects_exact_squad_number
preconditions: Squad number 50 does not exist in the database
actions: Assert Location header contains the exact squad_number value 50
expected: Body id field is a valid UUID
trace: R-PLAYER-027: Location path uses squad_number not UUID
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
import uuid
client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=True)

def test_post_player_location_header_reflects_exact_squad_number():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Carlos",
        "lastName": "Tevez",
        "squadNumber": 50,
        "position": "Centre-Forward",
        "team": "Boca Juniors",
        "league": "Primera Division"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    location = r.headers.get("location") or r.headers.get("Location")
    assert location == "/players/squadnumber/50"
    assert "/50" in location
    body = r.json()
    parsed_id = uuid.UUID(str(body["id"]))
    assert parsed_id is not None
    assert body["team"] == "Boca Juniors"

test_post_player_location_header_reflects_exact_squad_number()

tests.name: test_post_player_location_header_key_present_case_insensitive
preconditions: Squad number 77 does not exist in the database
actions: Check Location header key exists (case-insensitive) and value is exact
trace: R-PLAYER-027: Location header presence and exact value
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=True)

def test_post_player_location_header_key_present_case_insensitive():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Gabriel",
        "lastName": "Batistuta",
        "squadNumber": 77,
        "position": "Centre-Forward",
        "abbr_position": "CF"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    header_keys_lower = [k.lower() for k in r.headers.keys()]
    assert "location" in header_keys_lower
    location_value = r.headers.get("location") or r.headers.get("Location")
    assert location_value == "/players/squadnumber/77"
    assert location_value.startswith("/players/squadnumber/")
    assert location_value.endswith("/77")

test_post_player_location_header_key_present_case_insensitive()
